categories.evidence: Adds a GitHub Actions workflow in .github/workflows/ and a release verification script in contrib/devtools/
categories.rationale: Automating weekly checks of the Windows code signing certificate avoids relying on manual discovery during release candidate cycles. As noted in the discussion, point or expedited releases require functioning certificates on short notice, making automated advance warning of expiry or revocation worthwhile.
